data.title: Kangaroo Hops by 5s!
data.description: Join our friendly kangaroo as we hop along the number line by fives, building the foundation for multiplication!

character.imagePrompt: A cheerful cartoon kangaroo wearing a red scarf, ready to hop.

challenges.instruction: 2 numbers on the line are hidden. Type each missing number.
challenges.hint: Look at the numbers on each side of a "?". How far apart are the numbers next to each other?
